lines.text: Many learners say: I am looking forward to see you.
Better: I am looking forward to seeing you.
After look forward to, we say seeing.
The second! I look forward to seeing them.

data.wrong: I am looking forward to see you.
data.right: I am looking forward to seeing you.
data.why: After look forward to, we say seeing.

options: I look forward to see them.

native.tip: Depois de “look forward to”, o verbo termina em “-ing”: “seeing”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I am looking forward to see you.” O certo é “I am looking forward to seeing you.” Em português dizemos “ansioso para ver”, mas aqui o “to” pede o verbo com “-ing”. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “I look forward to seeing them.” Agora escreva uma frase sua com esse ponto e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: After “look forward to”, the verb ends in “-ing”: “seeing”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I am looking forward to see you.” The right way is “I am looking forward to seeing you.” In Portuguese we say “ansioso para ver”, but here “to” needs the verb with “-ing”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
